title: Special Weather Statement by NWS - NewsBreak
text:
16 minutes ago Check NWS updates here
Effective: 2026-07-29 22:57:00 CDT Expires: 2026-07-29 23:30:00 CDT Urgency: Expected Severity: Moderate Certainty: Observed Instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building. Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to localized flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways. Target Area: Central Walton; Holmes; Washington; Inland Bay At 1057 PM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 9 miles northwest of Vernon, moving south at 10 mph.
HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph.
SOURCE...Radar indicated.
IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around unsecured objects.
Locations impacted include... Vernon, Bonifay, Live Oak, Ponce De Leon, Caryville, Westville, Ebro, Hinsons Crossroads, Red Bay, Douglass Crossroad, Whitehead Crossroads, Cerrogordo, Gritney, Bruce, Red Head, Holmes Valley, Millers Ferry, Five Points, Pine Log, and Hulaw.
